alexcrichton opened PR #14612 from alexcrichton:uphold-more-contracts to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit refines the implementation of host-side polling of stream producers and consumers to more strictly check the requirements that trait implementations must adhere to in order to avoid giving the wrong results to guests. Notably if a stream returns complete without actually consuming anything, if a producer completes without actually producing anything, or if a producer both cancels and produces these are all traps now.
